name: What is the average cost for a custom kitchen renovation in Orange County?

mainEntity.name: What is the average cost for a custom kitchen renovation in Orange County?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a custom kitchen renovation in areas like Huntington Beach, Irvine, or Mission Viejo varies widely based on size, materials, and design complexity. A minor cosmetic update might start from $25,000, while a mid-range renovation could range from $45,000 to $80,000. High-end, luxury custom kitchens often exceed $100,000, especially with premium appliances, custom cabinetry, and structural changes. We provide detailed, transparent quotes after an initial consultation to align with your budget.
acceptedAnswer.description: Average costs for custom kitchen renovations in Orange County vary, typically from $25,000 for minor updates to over $100,000 for high-end projects.
